description: Dyson V15 Detect vs V12 Detect Slim in the US — a side-by-side of suction, runtime, weight, bin size and price, with a buying recommendation for each kind of buyer and live US listings.

heroBody: The Dyson V15 Detect and V12 Detect Slim share a laser dust-detection head and Dyson's anti-tangle cone, but they target meaningfully different buyers. The V15 is a full-size flagship with a 25% bigger bin and 60-minute full-power runtime; the V12 is a 1.5kg stick you can one-hand in a small flat. This page compares them side by side and pulls the live US listings from BuyWhere's catalog every few minutes so you can see the current price for each.

highlightSectionTitle: The real-world difference between the V15 and V12

highlights.title: Weight is the daily-life number
highlights.body: The V12 at 1.5kg is roughly half the V15's 3.1kg. If you do quick daily cleans above your head or up the stairs, the V12 is the one you'll actually pick up. If you mostly clean floors once a week, the V15's weight is a non-issue.

highlights.title: Bin size decides how often you empty
highlights.body: The V15's 0.77L bin is more than double the V12's 0.35L. With a shedding pet or a 100sqm+ house, the V12 needs emptying mid-clean. The V15 finishes a full house clean without touching the bin.

highlights.title: The suction gap matters on carpet
highlights.body: 230 AW versus 150 AW sounds like a number, but on mid-pile carpet with embedded pet hair the V15 pulls more in a single pass. On hard floors the two are roughly equal because there is nothing to dig out.

adviceSectionTitle: Which one should you actually buy?
advicePoints: Buy the V15 if you have more than 80sqm of floor, a shedding pet, or mostly carpet. The bigger bin and stronger suction earn the price gap, and you will not need to upgrade for years.

Buy the V12 if you live in a flat under 80sqm, mostly do quick daily cleans, and want one-hand operation on a staircase or above your head. The 1.5kg weight is the daily-life difference and worth the smaller bin.
If price is the primary driver, the V12 is the better deal. A new V12 sits clearly below a new V15 at US MSRP, and the gap widens during Dyson outlet and Costco sales.
Skip both if you only have hard floors and no pets — the V12's smaller sibling, the Dyson V8, does the job at half the price.
If you already own the V11, neither is a meaningful upgrade unless you want the laser dust head or the LCD screen. The V11 still cleans just as well and is on closeout.
faqSectionTitle: Dyson V15 vs V12 — common questions

faqs.question: Is the V15 worth the price premium over the V12 in the US?
faqs.answer: Yes if you have a pet or a large house — the bigger bin and stronger suction save real time every clean. No if you live in a flat and do quick daily cleans — the V12 is the smarter buy and the weight difference matters more than the spec sheet.

faqs.question: Do the V15 and V12 use the same attachments?
faqs.answer: Yes — all V11-and-newer Dyson stick attachments fit both. If you already own Dyson accessories from a V11, they carry over.

faqs.question: Is the V12 powerful enough for pet hair in the US?
faqs.answer: Yes on hard floors and low-pile carpet. On mid-pile or shag carpet with a heavy shedder, the V12 needs an extra pass and the smaller bin means emptying mid-clean. The V15 is the easier pet-household pick.

faqs.question: How long do the batteries last on each?
faqs.answer: Both run 60 minutes on eco and 30 minutes on medium. The V15 ships with a swappable battery on the Plus and Animal Pro SKUs, which effectively doubles runtime; the V12's battery is sealed.

faqs.question: Should I wait for the V16?
faqs.answer: There is no public launch date for a V16. The V15 and V12 are both current US models in 2026. Buy the one that fits your home and stop waiting — cordless technology has plateaued and the next refresh will be incremental.

categoryIntro.heading: Why the V15 vs V12 question is the most-asked Dyson comparison
categoryIntro.body: Dyson's V-series cordless line has been the best-selling premium stick vacuum in the US since 2020, and the V15 Detect and V12 Detect Slim are the two SKUs that show up most often in comparison queries from ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google. Both have the laser dust head, both have the anti-tangle cone, but they target genuinely different households — the side-by-side on this page is built to make that distinction clear.
